title: Rahon May Sarban Ko
body:
raahon mein sarban ko chaon mili na saaya
betaab dhoop mein hai zanjeer ka sataya
<<DIVIDER>>
ujde gharon mein goonji awaaz haye akbar
sughra ko jab phupi ne ro kar galay lagaya
raahon mein sarban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaana kacheriyon mein choota na bibiyon ka
aisa kisi adoo ne darbar mein bulaya
raahon mein sarban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardesiyon ki qabron mein turbate sakina
kisne hai phool daale kisne diya jalaya
raahon mein sarban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke sar mein ab tak hai rayt karbala ki
rassi ne baazuon mein kaala nishan banaya
raahon mein sarban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehchan lena sughra ab apne karwan ko
is khaafile mein bibi koi nahi paraya
raahon mein sarban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zahra ko yaad aaya pehlu ka koi sadma
durre ka neel maa ko zainab ne jab dikhaya
raahon mein sarban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shauhar bache na bhai susraal aur na meinka
bemaar tera bhai bewon ko saath laaya
raahon mein sarban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay manzilon pe maa'on se ro ke bache
ammi watan madina kyun ab talak na aaya
raahon mein sarban ko...
author: Baba Nisaar Haideri
